description: This file implements the SystemConfigurationServiceImpl class, a service layer component responsible for managing system configuration entities within the application. It extends a generic service implementation, provides a method to fetch configuration by key, and interacts with a DAO for data access.

classes.name: SystemConfigurationServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the SystemConfigurationService interface, providing methods to manage system configuration data, including retrieval by key.

methods.name: SystemConfigurationServiceImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DAO and passes it to the superclass.

methods.name: getByKey
methods.description: Retrieves a SystemConfiguration entity based on a provided key.
